faq.a1: Yes! TranEasy offers a completely free basic version with all core features including real-time translation and 100+ language support. No fees, no registration required — just download and start using.

faq.q9: Does TranEasy support photo and image translation?
faq.a9: Absolutely! TranEasy includes photo translation app and image translation software features, supporting AR photo translation and camera translation. Point at text to translate instantly — the perfect translation tool for reading menus and signs while traveling.
faq.q10: How low is TranEasy's translation latency?
faq.a10: TranEasy achieves ultra-low latency and near-zero delay translation. Voice real-time translation latency is just 0.3 seconds — the fastest real-time translation tool on the market, delivering an AI simultaneous interpretation experience.
faq.a11: Yes. TranEasy generates bilingual subtitles in real-time, perfect for video subtitle translation, live stream translation, and meeting translation. Whether international meeting translation or streaming translation, enjoy professional bilingual subtitle experiences.
faq.q12: What are floating translation and text selection translation?
faq.a12: Floating translation is TranEasy's signature feature — translations appear as a floating window on top of your screen without blocking content. Text selection translation lets you translate by selecting text with your mouse, supporting web page real-time translation and PDF translation for maximum productivity.
faq.q13: Is TranEasy suitable for international trade?
faq.a13: Absolutely. TranEasy is a professional business translation software supporting Chinese-English real-time translation and multilingual translation across 100+ languages. Whether video conferencing with overseas clients or processing trade documents, it's the best cross-language communication tool.
faq.a14: Yes. TranEasy includes built-in PDF translation software that translates entire PDF documents with one click while preserving original formatting. It also supports image translation and web page translation for various document scenarios.
faq.q15: How does TranEasy compare to iFlytek simultaneous interpretation?
faq.a15: Compared to iFlytek, TranEasy supports more languages (100+) and more platforms (50+), and offers a free real-time translation version. As an AI simultaneous interpretation tool, TranEasy also supports floating translation, text selection translation, photo translation and more — a more comprehensive translation solution.
